name: Default
shortDescription: Komodo Core, the web UI and API for building and deploying containers across many servers, backed by MongoDB.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated KOMODO_INIT_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables. The admin account is only created on the first start; change the password later in Komodo, not in the environment.
This template deploys Komodo Core only. To manage a server, create an onboarding key in the UI and install the Periphery agent on that server, pointing it at https://<your-domain>.
MongoDB 8 needs a CPU with AVX support. On older or emulated CPUs use the FerretDB variant instead.
